2.2 Part of speech tagging experiments We perform POS experiments using Universal De- pendencies (UD) (Nivre et al., 2016) data for 41 languages.3 We use the evaluation sets from Ze- man et al. Table 2 shows M-BERT zero- shot results for four European languages. We see that M-BERT generalizes well across languages, achieving over 80% accuracy for all pairs.

There is a big gap between this model’s zero-shot performance and M-BERT’s, showing that the pre-training is helping in cross-lingual transfer.
